subject: RE: Equinox renewal amendment — invoice routing & PO handoff
messages:
From: Alex Gross <alex.gross@equinox.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Finance AP <ap@equinox.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal amendment & PO — allocation between EU entities

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the renewal proposal. We want to accept the capacity increase but need to split the invoice across two legal entities in the EU for compliance with our local VAT teams. Our AP team needs a PO and the vendor name to match the invoice entity exactly.

Key asks:
- Can Redwood issue two invoices (50/50 split) under: Equinox AI SRL and Equinox AI GmbH?
- We will raise two POs. Can you confirm the exact payee names and EIN/VAT we should use on each invoice?
- We prefer Net45 on the larger invoice and Net30 on the smaller one — is that possible?

I attached a draft PO to show how our template will look. If it helps, we can e-sign the amendment once the payee fields are final.

Appreciate the help — Alex

Attachment: Equinox_PO_0429.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Gross <alex.gross@equinox.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Mar 2029 12:04:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Renewal amendment & PO — allocation between EU entities

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the PO stub. Looping in Vivek (head of commercial) and Neha (billing ops) so we can align on entity-level details.

Short answers up front:
- Yes, we can support two invoices split by percentage.
- We need to confirm bank/payee names for each invoice and whether you require separate W-8/W-9 style certs (for EU that would be VAT registration numbers).
- Mixing Net30/Net45 is doable, but it needs explicit mapping in the amendment so our billing system schedules two invoice runs.

Next steps I propose: Vivek to confirm payee/legal names and Neha to provide the amendment template we use for split invoicing. Once we agree, I can route DocuSign to Alex for signature and your AP can submit the two POs.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Renewal & Expansion
Redwood Inference
